newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia "massacre" reports likely false - police.
newsitem.headline: Colombia "massacre" reports likely false - police.

text.p: Reports that leftist rebels massacred at least 40 people in a remote region of northwest Colombia on Saturday cannot be confirmed and appear to be false, police said.
"We have carried out checks and have been unable to confirm any such reports. To the best of our knowledge this report is false," said Col. Mario Ramirez, of the national police, based in Bogota.
The rumour that National Liberation Army (ELN) rebels had fired on a boat in the Gulf of Uraba, near the town of Rio Sucio, in Choco province, first emerged early on Saturday night.
Police said the first unconfirmed reports had come from an amateur radio operator.
The ELN did, however, storm the town on Friday and killed one policeman and injured three others.
The region where the massacre was said to have taken place is, extremely isolated and news takes days or even weeks to filter out.
